summary:
bash: cd /app && python -c "
import mujoco
m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('model_ref.xml')
print('timestep:', m.opt.timestep)
print('nq:', m.nq, 'nv:', m.nv, 'nbody:', m.nbody, 'ngeom:', m.ngeom, 'njnt:', m.njnt)
print('nconmax:', m.opt.conmax)
print('opt:', m.opt.timestep, m.opt.iterations, m.opt.ls_iterations, m.opt.disableflags)
print('nplugin:', m.nplugin, [m.plugin_id2name(i) for i in range(m.nplugin)])
print('nsensordata:', m.nsensordata)
"
